He is holding a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) in his right hand, positioning it near his forehead where there appears to be a dark smudge or wound. He has another small white bandage on his upper lip. He is wearing a white tank top. The background is plain white.

The fingers holding the bandage appear slightly fused and lack clear definition between joints. The thumb position and connection to the palm look anatomically awkward and slightly distorted.
The bandage being held has significant motion blur or focus issues that make the edges soft, contrasting with the sharper face, which may indicate generation inconsistency.
